definition.text: Strength of God. (1.) One of the sons of Kohath, and uncle of Aaron (Ex. 6:18; Lev. 10:4). (2.) A Simeonite captain (1 Chr. 4:39-43). (3.) A son of Bela, and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:7). (4.) One of the sons of Heman (1 Chr. 25:4); called also Azareel (18). (5.) A son of Jeduthan (2 Chr. 29:14). (6.) The son of Harhaiah (Neh. 3:8).

lemmas.gloss: Uzziel, the name of six Israelites
Mishael, the name of three Israelites
Jerimoth or Jeremoth, the name of twelve Israelites
Heman, the name of at least two Israelites
Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites
